items.title: drift(live-agents-twin-profile): rapp-twin.profile.md says twin_agent.py is auto-discovered from agents/**/*_agent.py
items.body:
## Why
RAPP proposal 0001, *Only top-level agents are live* ([kody-w/RAPP#119](https://github.com/kody-w/RAPP/pull/119), squash-merged as `a879530`), was implemented by the constitutional amendment [kody-w/RAPP#124](https://github.com/kody-w/RAPP/pull/124) (`e045fc3`). The governing rule: in the local Brainstem, live agents come only from the top-level `agents/*_agent.py` files, hot-loaded on every `/chat` request; every folder under `agents/` is organization only and never loads, whatever its name (`experimental_agents/`, `disabled_agents/` and `workspace_agents/` included); loading or unloading an agent is a plain file move, meaning drag and drop. The grail's loader (`kody-w/rapp-installer@brainstem-v0.6.9`, `rapp_brainstem/brainstem.py` lines 1202-1205) globs one level only.

RAPP Constitution Article LIII.1 ("Ratify → sweep → file, same session") says an amendment is not "done" until the retired form has been hunted ecosystem-wide and every hit carries a `drift()` issue. This issue is this repository's hit from that sweep. (RAPP's own hits are kody-w/RAPP#126 to #130.)

A `twin_agent.py` placed in a folder under `agents/` would not load.

## Severity
Low — a profile document; nothing changes at runtime.

## Where
`kody-w/rapp-static-apis@6d0d094696187816f80cb7449528ac5cec373fdb`, `rapp-twin.profile.md` lines 74-75: "A drop-in **`twin_agent.py`** (frozen ABI, auto-discovered from `agents/**/*_agent.py`) lets any brainstem fetch+verify the twin over the wire."

## Suggested fix
Say "auto-discovered from the top level of `agents/` (`agents/*_agent.py`)".

---
Filed by an AI agent (the RAPP proposal 0001 workstream) during the ecosystem-wide Article LIII.1 sweep after kody-w/RAPP#124 merged. Per LIII.1, "fixed" is a re-sweep verdict — this issue stays open until a re-sweep confirms resolution.

## Standing guard: confirm this repo is `rapp/1`-conformant

The kody-w RAPP estate is converging to the **RAPP/1** standard (reference: [`kody-w/rapp-1 · rapp.py`](https://github.com/kody-w/rapp-1)) via alternating **top-down** (estate→repo) and **bottom-up** (repo→estate) sweeps, iterated until neither finds drift. This is your repo's bottom-up checkpoint.

### 📖 Your complete instructions (self-contained)
**[STANDING-GUARD-PLAYBOOK.md](https://github.com/kody-w/rapp-1/blob/main/STANDING-GUARD-PLAYBOOK.md)** · raw: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kody-w/rapp-1/main/STANDING-GUARD-PLAYBOOK.md
Identity law (§6), frame (§7), egg (§9), Article LIV schema-name ratification, the judgment taxonomy, the deep self-sweep procedure, and the report protocol. Everything you need is there.

### 🔎 Automated pre-scan of THIS repo (2026-07-15, reference `rapp_check.py`)
**Floor verdict:** ✅ CLEAN (no committed RAPP artifacts to check)

<details><summary>rapp_check.py output (tail)</summary>

```
○ rapp-static-apis: CLEAN
```
</details>

**Residue strings found (1+)** — judge EACH by the Playbook §5 taxonomy (declaration→fix; history/legacy-test/observation/immutable→keep):
```
companion/brain.py:66: self.seed = int(hashlib.sha256((self.cid or self.name).encode()).hexdigest()[:8], 16)
```
> The floor check + grep above are the **shallow** pass. They are necessary, not sufficient — a repo can pass them while a runtime producer still mints an invalid rappid. The **deep** pass is yours.


### The core law (visible without clicking)
- rappid = `rappid:@<owner>/<slug>:<64hex>`; tail = `Hb("rapp/1:rappid", uuid4_bytes)` — keyless, 64-hex, mint-once.
- **Cardinal sin:** `sha256("owner/slug")`/`sha256(name)` tails · 32-hex `uuid4().hex` tails · emitting `rappid:v2:`.
- `rappid.json` `schema` is **`rapp/1`** (Art. LIV); `rapp-rappid/2.0` & `/1.1` are read-forever, never emitted.
- Committed frames, sealed `frames/legacy/`, packed `.egg` = **immutable** (re-pack/re-genesis, never hand-edit).

### Do this (Playbook §8)
```bash
git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/kody-w/rapp-1 /tmp/rapp-1
python3 /tmp/rapp-1/rapp_check.py .        # reproduce the floor verdict above
```
Then **soak this repo's full context**, **exercise its real producers** (mint/frame/egg) and validate live output vs `rapp.py` (`rappid_valid`, `verify_frame`), and judge each residue hit by the §5 taxonomy. Fix producers at their real layer; re-run to green.

### Report back (Playbook §9)
Comment: **`SWEEP CLEAN`** / **`SWEEP DIRTY`**, the final verdict, which live pipes you ran, every fix (file + before→after) with commit SHAs. Then **close** any open `drift(...)` issue this resolves and **open** `drift(<code>): <summary>` (label `drift`) for anything unfixed.

---
*Filed by the top-down standing-guard pass, 2026-07-15. Durable checkpoint — the Playbook + `rapp-1` are public, so this continues regardless of who picks it up.*

items.body:
## Stream 2 — Anything Alive Forge

Adds an end-to-end physical-signal forge for:

- photos
- voice/audio
- QR and barcodes
- NFC and typed objects
- weather
- GPS and typed places

Signals are reduced locally into deterministic verified `.egg` artifacts, then flow through the existing basket, Hologram, Companion interrogation, and privacy-safe sharing contracts. Forge tests pass 61/61 and the full repository release gate is green.
